description: Governance checks used by tools_governance.py: gate, audit, secrets, and the seven test dimensions required by the AutoForge catalog.

gate_rules.label: High/critical risk has a named approver
A preview/dry-run path exists before mutating state
No inline credentials in bundle, config, or generated files
A documented way to stop or drain the automation exists

test_dimensions.label: Normal path
test_dimensions.description: Happy path on fixture data completes with exit code 0.

test_dimensions.label: Boundary inputs
test_dimensions.description: Empty input, max size, unusual names, and zero rows behave predictably.
test_dimensions.example: pass an empty input directory and a 1-byte file

test_dimensions.label: Failure handling
test_dimensions.description: Bad input and unavailable dependency produce a structured error, not a crash.
test_dimensions.example: point input_dir at a missing path and confirm exit code 2

test_dimensions.label: Repeat / idempotency
test_dimensions.description: Running twice creates no duplicate records or repeated side effects.
test_dimensions.example: run twice and diff output counts and audit entries

test_dimensions.label: Concurrency
test_dimensions.description: Two overlapping runs respect the lock and do not corrupt state.
test_dimensions.example: launch two runs with the same lock file

test_dimensions.label: Recovery
test_dimensions.description: After an injected failure the job restarts within the retry bound or stops safely.
test_dimensions.example: kill the run mid-way, then re-run and check the audit trail

test_dimensions.label: Clean state
test_dimensions.description: A fresh run in an empty workspace behaves the same as in a used workspace.
test_dimensions.example: copy the project to a new directory and run once

sensitive_input_policy.on_sensitive_key: store sha256 of the value and the field name only
